title: AdaJudge: Adaptive Multi-Perspective Judging for Reward Modeling
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical architecture of reward models for LLM alignment. While it includes a 'Safety' evaluation category (e.g., detecting harmful or unethical requests like shoplifting), it treats this as a standard benchmark metric and does not provide a dedicated evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
